paragraphs:
Shimon. Rav Adda son of R' Shimon; R' Illai son of R' Shimon—I did not find him; R' Yehudah son of R' Shimon.

[Glosses: Shimon. (a) Bava Metzia 85a: R' Shimon ben Issi ben Lakunya, “his mother's sister.” It should read “brother,” as in Ein Yaakov. ל״ת [provisionally: not corrected]. (b) Shabbat 54b; Yevamot 97, beginning of side a; Jerusalem Shekalim, end of chapter 2; Jerusalem Shabbat 2:3: R' Shimon Nezira. In Shabbat 33b: R' Shimon ben Nezira. ל״ת [provisionally: not corrected]. (c) Bekhorot 47b: R' Shimon Yasinya said; elsewhere, ben Yasini. (d) Kiddushin 76b: R' Shimon ben Zeira. Perhaps it should read Shemayah ben Zeira, who is mentioned several times in the Talmud. ל״ת [provisionally: not corrected]. (e) Zevahim 65b: Rabbi Shimon bar Rav Yitzhak. It seems to me that it should read Rav Shmuel bar Rav Yitzhak, as in בשס״ח [provisionally the new Talmud editions; uncollated]. (f) Pesahim 91a: R' Shimon son of R' Yohanan ben Berokah. It seems to me it should read R' Yishmael. ל״ת [provisionally: not corrected]. (g) Bava Metzia 22, beginning of side b: R' Yohanan said in R' Yishmael bar Yehotzadak's name. In that matter on 27a: R' Yohanan said in R' Shimon ben Yohai's name. It seems to me that both places have scribal errors and should read R' Shimon ben Yehotzadak. Afterward I examined Yalkut, Ki Tetze, no. 930, which brings both foregoing matters; in both places it reads R' Shimon ben Yehotzadak, and it pleased me.]
